turns.question: Who was our best customer in September 2026, and how much did they spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that ranks or names individual customers (no per-customer dimension exists), so I cannot say who the best customer was or what they spent. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (Revenue), customers_distinct (Active customers) and repeat_customers, which can be split by customer country, signup cohort or order status but not by customer.
